 Dengue claims 11 more lives
 Daily death toll hits a record high this year 
 Published : 27 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 27 October 2026, 17:16
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least 11 people died of dengue, and 2,071 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00 am, marking the highest single-day death toll of the year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 With the latest deaths and cases, the number of fatalities from the mosquito-borne disease has risen to 400, while the total number of cases has reached 1,28,237.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 Currently, 6,415 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country, while 1,21,422 have been discharged so far.
